description:
It’s been almost 5 years since Hyeon-Seo’s wife, Ju-Ha, has passed. Yet he’s still not over the hurt and the lingering feelings of love he carries for his late wife. But who should come knocking on his door one day is none other than Ju-Ha’s younger brother, his brother-in-law, Yu-Ha. Just having come back from studying abroad, Yu-Ha needs a place to stay until he can get a place of his own. Hyeon-Seo gladly lets him stay at his place, but the problem is that Yu-Ha looks too much alike Ju-Ha… And looks like someone’s been sporting a crush all these years, and now that he’s all grown-up and Hyeon-Seo is available, he’s not afraid to make a move and give into these taboo temptations…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five side story chapters.*
